baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural imperatives to eat and drink, the qualifier hani'an, and the causal-looking bi-ma kuntum ta'malun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intentional activity located in the recipients' past issues in a present authorization to take nourishment as an easy, wholesome benefit.

activation_trace.role: Literal food ingestion supplies the first bodily act of the authorized benefit.
Literal liquid intake completes the paired bodily enjoyment.
Benefit without hardship or harmful consequence makes the consumption more than mere satiation.
Temporal predication locates the relevant doing as an established past condition.
Intentional doing supplies the human action to which the present enjoyment answers.

changed_reading.before: A bare invitation to consume food and drink.
changed_reading.after: A present, unhindered bodily benefit is made consequentially continuous with sustained intentional action in the past.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linkage of eating and drinking to ta'malun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of allotted provision, allotted water, and pay for work let the meal function as compensation converted into something directly consumable.

activation_trace.role: Eating can name a consumable allotment, casting the food as one's assigned provision.
The water-share branch gives the drink the shape of a measured allotment.
Pay for work supplies the compensatory relation between prior action and present provision.
Giving and maintenance make the compensation sustaining rather than merely notional.

changed_reading.before: Good action receives an unspecified reward.
changed_reading.after: The reward is pictured as an allotted wage that can be eaten, drunk, and lived from.

baseline_models.mechanism: Drinking branches of permeation and understanding shift reward from an external possession to a beneficial condition taken inward without resistance.

activation_trace.role: Imbuing color or heart supplies the material image of reward permeating its recipient.
Absorption as understanding opens an epistemic as well as bodily sense of taking in.
Wholesome ease keeps the inward passage beneficial and unobstructed.

changed_reading.before: Recipients are handed pleasant objects to consume.
changed_reading.after: They are invited to let the reward enter, permeate, and become an inwardly settled condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical past-work formula first closes a scene of compelled fire-exposure and then closes the invitation to eat and drink. The focus eating branch that also images fire consuming fuel turns the pair into a reversal of agency: being consumed gives way to consuming.

activation_trace.role: Fire feeding on fuel supplies a reversible consumption image anchored inside the focus command to eat.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the bodily fate opposed to wholesome ingestion.
Matching an act with its consequence marks both scenes as action-responsive outcomes.
Intentional doing repeats the focus ayah's human input almost verbatim.
Harmless ease provides the positive pole against the preceding bodily harm.

structural_cues: 52:13-16 drives people toward fire, whereas 52:19 makes the plural addressees agents of consumption; both outcomes terminate in the same kuntum ta'malun construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire-exposure, act-matched recompense, the repeated work formula, and a focus branch where fire itself eats; I supply the reversible consumer/consumed arrow. A live alternative is simple contrast between two destinies without the agency inversion.

changed_reading.before: The wholesome meal is an independent reward scene.
changed_reading.after: The meal reverses the preceding punishment at the level of bodily agency: the same action-consequence hinge separates being consumed from being able to consume.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's work-based rationale sits beside giving, nurturing, protection, and later release without counterpayment. This keeps a wage reading live while denying that wage alone exhausts the meal's causality.

activation_trace.role: Pay for work keeps genuine compensatory force in the focus clause.
Giving supplies a source of delight located in the giver rather than in the recipients' labor.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion frame both gift and protection as sustained lordly care.
Protective prevention adds rescue from harm to the positive provision.
Release without exchange keeps gratuitous favor active beside compensation.

structural_cues: Adjacent 52:18 and 52:19 use two bi-ma clauses, first for what the Lord gave and then for what the recipients used to do; 52:27 later names favor and protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent gift/protection and work rationales plus later gratuitous release; I infer two coexisting causal frames rather than reducing either to the other. Merit-only and gift-only readings remain materially live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: The meal is exclusively earned pay for deeds.
changed_reading.after: The meal bears both an earned-wage reading and a gifted-protection reading, with their causal priority left unresolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Former care mixed with fear is followed by favor, protection, and mercy. In that affective sequence, hani'an and the imperatives do not merely permit eating; they assure the recipients that vigilance can finally be released.

activation_trace.role: Benefit without hardship or bad aftereffect anchors the promised easing of vigilance.
Care mixed with fear supplies the prior affective posture that the meal reverses.
Unbought release supplies the transition out of the former guarded state.
Protection from damage makes relaxed consumption possible.
Merciful tenderness supplies the relational ground of the assurance.

structural_cues: The later recollection moves from fear within the family to favor, protection, remembered calling, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, release, protection, mercy, and wholesome ease; I infer that the commands perform assurance by authorizing lowered vigilance. A live alternative is that they are ordinary imperatives with no affective speech-act force.

changed_reading.before: Eat and drink simply tells the recipients what is available.
changed_reading.after: Eat and drink also tells formerly apprehensive recipients that they may stop bracing for harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch in which eating names crop-yield joins work that is not diminished, continuing increase, and actual fruit. This activates a productive model that competes with simple wage exchange: deeds ripen into consumable yield.

activation_trace.role: Fruit or crop-yield lets eating name the realized product rather than only the act of ingestion.
Intentional work supplies what can metaphorically bear the resulting yield.
The repeated intentional-work branch carries the focus mechanism into the explicit non-diminution statement.
Diminution, explicitly negated in its source, marks the work-product as undiminished.
Connected increase or material support makes the provision continue beyond a fixed payout.
Actual pleasant fruit materializes the focus eating branch's yield image.

structural_cues: 52:21 refuses any reduction of their work, and 52:22 immediately extends them fruit and meat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a yield branch, undiminished work, connected increase, and fruit; I supply the ripening arrow from deed to edible product. The live alternative is juridical payment, already retained in the consumable-wage model.

changed_reading.before: Food is exchanged for prior work as an external payment.
changed_reading.after: Prior work is pictured as an undiminished productive growth whose yield has become edible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joining descendants without reducing anyone's work, mutually drawing a cup, and facing one another activate the co-drinker branch. The plural meal becomes shared abundance rather than parallel private rations.

activation_trace.role: Drinkers and co-drinkers turn the plural command into a social act.
A later party catching up and joining supplies familial inclusion.
Negated diminution makes inclusion non-subtractive rather than a division of fixed shares.
Mutual drawing between two sides gives the cup circulation and reciprocity.
A group turning face-to-face supplies the meal's conversational social geometry.

structural_cues: The sequence expands from plural eating to paired reclining, descendants joining, cup exchange, service, and face-to-face questioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, no diminution, reciprocal cup movement, and face-to-face gathering; I infer that these realize the focus plurals as nonzero-sum fellowship. A live alternative treats them as adjacent amenities rather than one social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Each recipient privately consumes an individual allotment.
changed_reading.after: The invitation opens a shared table whose fellowship can expand without reducing any participant's portion or work-credit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desired food and a cup stripped of worthless speech and sin specify hani'an as clean incorporation. Protection from something poisonous that enters the body adds a material counterimage: this pleasure permeates without toxic, moral, or social residue.

activation_trace.role: Permeation into color or heart makes drinking an inward exposure whose quality matters.
Wholesome benefit without bad consequence anchors the absence of residue.
The soul's movement toward what it desires supplies positive appetite rather than compulsion.
A cup together with its contents makes the context an exact specification of drinking.
Discardable, uncounted residue is explicitly absent from the cup's setting.
Loading someone with sin is negated, removing moral burden from the drink.
Protective prevention supplies the barrier against harmful entry.
Poison entering the body supplies the material opposite of wholesome permeation.

structural_cues: 52:22 names desired food, 52:23 grammatically removes laghw and ta'thim from the cup, and 52:27 recalls protection from al-samum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appetite, cup, negated discursive and moral byproducts, bodily poison, protection, and wholesome permeation; I infer a unified residue-filtering mechanism. Live alternatives restrict the cleanliness either to social conduct or to eschatological safety alone.

changed_reading.before: Hani'an means only that the meal tastes pleasant.
changed_reading.after: Hani'an marks desire fulfilled through an intake cleansed of physiological threat, moral loading, and social afterdamage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions about treasuries and a fee that would leave hearers financially burdened qualify the focus wage model. The meal is compensation, but not a toll, debt, or extraction imposed on its recipients.

activation_trace.role: Consumable provision supplies the allocated economic good.
Pay for work keeps the compensation model active.
Ease without harmful consequence marks the provision as unencumbered.
Guarded stores supply the larger economy from which provision could issue.
Compensation for work directly echoes the focus wage branch.
A binding financial liability supplies the negated debt-side of the economy.
Being loaded down makes the denied fee's burden bodily palpable.

structural_cues: 52:37 denies the opponents control of the Lord's treasuries, and 52:40 denies a fee demand that would weigh them down with liability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stores, compensation, liability, burden, and wholesome provision; I infer that the negated fee frame constrains the focus's wage metaphor to compensation without extraction. A live alternative confines 52:40 entirely to prophetic remuneration.

changed_reading.before: The meal resembles an ordinary payment transaction.
changed_reading.after: It is compensatory yet unencumbered: provision comes without an access fee, creditor, or debt-weight attached to enjoyment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated retrospective kunna clauses and closing actions assigned to standing, night, and the stars' retreat sharpen kuntum ta'malun into habituated practice distributed across time, not a single qualifying deed.

activation_trace.role: Being present in time anchors the focus's durative retrospective construction.
Intentional action supplies what the temporal frame repeatedly contains.
Another retrospective state extends the surah's pattern of looking back on durable former conditions.
Worship through praise supplies a recurring intentional practice.
Assigning a known time to an act gives the practice temporal articulation.
Rising with resolve toward an act gives the timed practice renewed initiation.
Pursuing an act at night extends practice beyond a single daytime moment.
The end and passing aftermath of a thing supplies a recurrent temporal boundary.

structural_cues: Kunna recurs in 52:14, 52:16, 52:26, and 52:28, while 52:48-49 closes with practices indexed to rising, night, and the retreat of stars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated retrospective predication and explicitly timed worship; I infer that the focus past progressive gathers a pattern of life rather than isolated acts. A live alternative limits the closing timings to commands unrelated to the rewarded work.

changed_reading.before: A deed or set of deeds qualifies the recipients for a meal.
changed_reading.after: The meal answers a durable temporal habit of intentional action carried through recurring thresholds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves through inhabited shelter, roof, and a sea ambiguously filled or kindled; the upheaval then destabilizes sky and mountains. Focus branches for eating and drinking places miniaturize that architecture into a restored hospitable container where intake is again ordered and safe.

activation_trace.role: An eating vessel or place turns the command toward the container that makes nourishment available.
A drinking place or vessel supplies the corresponding liquid container.
Shelter and dwelling supply the large-scale image of a protected interior.
A group inhabiting a place makes the shelter socially occupied rather than empty.
The high roof supplies an enclosing upper boundary.
Fullness with water supplies a contained abundance analogous to a filled vessel.
Kindling and intensifying fire keeps the same container poised between nourishment and threat.
Oscillation and wave-like motion destabilize the upper frame that had acted as roof.
Removal and displacement strip the landscape of its former fixed supports.

structural_cues: The oath sequence presents a spread sheet, inhabited house, raised roof, and filled or kindled sea before sky and mountains lose stability; the meal follows the destructive sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested containers, occupation, filling or kindling, and cosmic displacement; I supply the scale-analogy from cosmos and house to cup and eating place. A live alternative treats the oath images and meal setting as independent domains.

changed_reading.before: The focus provides food and drink within an unspecified setting.
changed_reading.after: The meal also images restored habitability: after cosmic containers fail, ordered vessels and a shared place safely hold what can be taken in.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the focus eating root's non-dominant split mapping, whose branches concern totality and a surrounding crown rather than ingestion. It remains packet-anchored through the supplied split and the focus word itself, but downstream prose should render it only as a formal resonance of being wholly surrounded by benefit, never as a replacement translation for eat.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch of totality and completeness supplies an echo of enjoyment taken without remainder.
A crown or surrounding ring supplies the spatial image of benefit enclosing the recipients.
Wholesome ease specifies the quality of the proposed total enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Eating is only a discrete act directed at food.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary resonance, the imperative lets enjoyment be taken wholly and surround the recipients without remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a context word of seeing activates a non-dominant mapped branch of quenching thirst, crossing vision and drinking. It remains valid as a packet-supplied split-root analogy and is reinforced by the focus drinking branch of understanding, but prose should qualify it as epistemic hydration imagery rather than lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus command to drink and its branch of absorption as understanding.

activation_trace.role: Drinking as understanding anchors a cross-domain movement from intake to knowing.
Insight of the heart supplies the denied mode of perception that needs resolution.
Settled knowledge without doubt supplies the epistemic endpoint.
The non-dominant quenching branch turns persistent mis-seeing into an image of thirst left unsatisfied.

changed_reading.before: The command satisfies bodily thirst after the truth has already been settled.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, drinking also quenches the epistemic thirst exposed by failed sight, misnaming, and lack of certainty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context noun for each person carries a branch for digestible food, allowing the accountability clause to touch the focus's wholesome eating. The link is branch-backed and anchored in the meal, acquisition, and pledge sequence, but the arrow from held collateral to digestible benefit is reader-supplied and should appear only as a tentative bodily analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Eating hani'an because of prior work.

activation_trace.role: Literal ingestion anchors the context's unexpected digestibility branch in the focus action.
Easy wholesome benefit supplies the quality of being safely digestible.
The digestible-food branch hidden under the word for person creates the bodily bridge to hani'an.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies what the person has acquired.
Collateral held against a right supplies the obstructed state contrasted with easy intake.

changed_reading.before: The individual pledge statement and the pleasant meal are separate legal and sensory images.
changed_reading.after: Tentatively, acquired action moves from holding the person like collateral to returning as benefit the person can take in without obstruction.

strongest_changes: The repeated work formula makes 52:19 a reversal from being consumed by fire to becoming an agent who consumes.
Adjacent gift, protection, work, and gratuitous favor keep grace and compensation active as distinct causal readings.
Undiminished work plus extended fruit activates an edible-yield model that competes with ordinary wage exchange.
The cup's negated residue and protection from penetrating poison deepen hani'an into clean, unburdened incorporation.
Joining without diminution and reciprocal cup movement turn the plural commands into nonzero-sum fellowship.
summary.what_was_special: Material branches made the ayah change scale and direction: deeds could become wage or crop-yield, drinking could permeate understanding, and the fire sequence could reverse who consumes whom. Packet-supplied non-dominant mappings also preserved contained resonances of total enclosure and epistemic quenching that a conservative reading would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal force of bi-ma can support recompense, occasion, or accompaniment, and the packet does not force one relation.
Gift and work remain jointly active without resolving whether one grounds or merely describes the other.
The house-vessel-cosmos scale analogy is coherent but depends heavily on a reader-supplied directional bridge.
Non-dominant split mappings are structurally licensed but should not be mistaken for surface-word senses.
